name: Data.isHCParam_Y
summary: Write k_D = k + 1; match the indices of Y_m (the block R and m blocks of t) with the steps of the Harish-Chandra parameter computed by `hcParameter_eq_of_steps`, and check the entries.

steps.lean:
(D.paramY D.m) := have ⟨k, _⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_one.2 D.k_pos
  have hL {T} x := ((@finProdFinEquiv D.m T x).natAdd k).2
  by refine fun τ ↦ ⟨(hasGap_gridParam ..).1,
    (?_ : _ = Fintype.card (D.Y _)) ▸ ((@gridBlockEquiv _ _ D false 0).forall_congr' fun _ ↦
    exists_congr fun _ ↦ and_congr_right (hcParameter_eq_of_steps τ (fun p ↦ 2 * (D.rowParameter
    τ (p ⊓ k) - p.sub k) - (D.h - D.t.succ) * (2 * ((p - k) / D.t.succ) + (p - k) % D.t.succ ⊓ 1 :))
    (fun p ↦ dite (p < k) ?_ ?_) (hL (⟨_, D.m_eq_two_mul_varrho_add_two.ge⟩, ⊤)) ?_
    _ · |>.congr_right)).mpr fun | .inl (.inl ⟨y, _⟩) => if _ : y ≤
    k then ⟨y, ?_⟩ else ⟨_, hL (⟨y - k, ?_⟩, 0), ?_⟩ | .inr (a, b) => ⟨_, hL (a,
    b.succ), ?_⟩⟩ <;> simp_intro .. [*, tsub_eq_zero_of_le, le_of_lt, columnsY, κ, keptColumns,
    Nat.succ_div, Nat.succ_sub, rowParameter, reducedHalfGap, w, hcParameter, lastEntry, n,
    Nat.add_mul_div_left, paramY, m_eq_two_mul_varrho_add_two, gridParam, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero,
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, Nat.div_eq_of_lt] <;> grind [sum_eq_zero, diagramWeight_apply]

steps.claim: For every T and x, the index of x among the blocks lies at least k beyond the start (hL, from `finProdFinEquiv`).
steps.lean: have hL {T} x := ((@finProdFinEquiv D.m T x).natAdd k).2

steps.claim: At each infinite place τ: the gap condition of the grid parameter (`hasGap_gridParam`), and, through the block equivalence of Y_m (`Data.gridBlockEquiv`), each entry of paramY is the Harish-Chandra parameter computed by the step formula `hcParameter_eq_of_steps` with the steps 2(ϱ(τ, min(p, k)) − (p − k)) − (h − t − 1)(2⌊(p − k)/(t + 1)⌋ + min((p − k) mod (t + 1), 1)), the cases of the first block (y ≤ k or not) and of the other blocks being matched with explicit indices.
steps.lean:
by refine fun τ ↦ ⟨(hasGap_gridParam ..).1,
    (?_ : _ = Fintype.card (D.Y _)) ▸ ((@gridBlockEquiv _ _ D false 0).forall_congr' fun _ ↦
    exists_congr fun _ ↦ and_congr_right (hcParameter_eq_of_steps τ (fun p ↦ 2 * (D.rowParameter
    τ (p ⊓ k) - p.sub k) - (D.h - D.t.succ) * (2 * ((p - k) / D.t.succ) + (p - k) % D.t.succ ⊓ 1 :))
    (fun p ↦ dite (p < k) ?_ ?_) (hL (⟨_, D.m_eq_two_mul_varrho_add_two.ge⟩, ⊤)) ?_
    _ · |>.congr_right)).mpr fun | .inl (.inl ⟨y, _⟩) => if _ : y ≤
    k then ⟨y, ?_⟩ else ⟨_, hL (⟨y - k, ?_⟩, 0), ?_⟩ | .inr (a, b) => ⟨_, hL (a,
    b.succ), ?_⟩⟩

steps.claim: The remaining arithmetic identities (definitions of columnsY, κ, the kept columns, rowParameter, the reduced half gap, w, lastEntry, n, paramY, gridParam, m = 2ϱ + 2) hold by simplification and arithmetic.
steps.lean:
<;> simp_intro .. [*, tsub_eq_zero_of_le, le_of_lt, columnsY, κ, keptColumns,
    Nat.succ_div, Nat.succ_sub, rowParameter, reducedHalfGap, w, hcParameter, lastEntry, n,
    Nat.add_mul_div_left, paramY, m_eq_two_mul_varrho_add_two, gridParam, Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero,
    Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, Nat.div_eq_of_lt] <;> grind [sum_eq_zero, diagramWeight_apply]
